choices.text: What did you think about the castle?
What did you think about the ruins?
What did you think about the giany freaky polar bear cave?

speaker: Sullivan
text: You wouldn't expect a lord to be that...weird. I guess money does change people...

speaker: You
text: I kinda understand him. Imagine if you had all that money and someone was trying to take it from you.

speaker: Sullivan
text: I'd donate most of my money. All to the orphans. They'd live in mansions.

speaker: You
text: You'd laugh in their face like that too?

speaker: Sullivan
text: I'd smile because I was happy for them.

speaker: You
text: Would you give me anything?

speaker: Sullivan
text: Are you an orphan?

speaker: You
text: You'd only give money to orphans? Not sick kids or widows or poor people?

speaker: Sullivan
text: Do you have the plague? Syphillis?

speaker: You
text: Unless you haven't been careful, no

speaker: Sullivan
text: Are you a widow?

speaker: You
text: No..

speaker: Sullivan
text: Maybe I'd hire you to clean my palaces.

speaker: You
text: I'm still poor. You could give me money for land

speaker: Sullivan
text: Do you even know how to farm?

speaker: You
text: We should probably find someone who does. We could live off the land, be self sustaining.

speaker: Sullivan
text: When we stop chasing around after treasures, I'll love to see you try to grow anything.

speaker: Sullivan
text: I definetly feel bad for Whitney. Having to spend so many years being someone's property..

speaker: You
text: Yea, it's horrible. Can't blame her for being so hellbent on revenge.

speaker: Sullivan
text: I wish there was a way to help out..

speaker: You
text: Yea, if only you'd have had some weapons to give her...

speaker: Sullivan
text: If only someone here had just happened to find a lot of money recently...

speaker: You
text: It would've atleast helped if someone would've had a means of transport...

speaker: Sullivan
text: Or if someone who knew how to fight would come help...

speaker: You
text: You've got to be feeling real guilty about not being able to help...

speaker: Sullivan
text: Well, if she were to ask, maybe I'd try to find something to spare.

speaker: You
text: Don't overexert yourself!

speaker: Sullivan
text: I'm serious. I don't know how people can just sit by and watch these things happen.

speaker: You
text: Well, I hope she atleast feels comfortable enough to let us know if we can help in some way.

speaker: Sullivan
text: The only reason you're alive is because that bear knew you don't have enough nutrients in you.

speaker: You
text: Next time, you could welcome me with a home-cooked meal

speaker: Sullivan
text: I've been told I look good in an apron

speaker: You
text: Who's been telling you things like this?

speaker: Sullivan
text: That's none of your business!

speaker: You
text: Well, it's just because I don't see how much an apron would change things.

speaker: Sullivan
text: Fuck you, man. From now you're scavengning your own food.

speaker: You
text: Like a bear?

speaker: Sullivan
text: If you want to try out the look, I can help you out.

choices.text: Can you tell me anything about this?

speaker: Sullivan
text: About what?

speaker: Sullivan
text: I certainly wouldn't mind a break. Anyhwere in particular?

speaker: Sullivan
text: Something about myself? Like what?

requires.text: What were you doing before being a traveling merchant?

requires.speaker: Sullivan
requires.text: Are you trying to set me up with someone?
